inset_map.title: Inset Star Map
inset_map.about: The small galaxy map with the fleets' stars, scaled in at its own proportion; hovering a star scans it.

ship_panel.title: Ship Panel
ship_panel.about: The glass panel at the lower left that holds the scanned ship's data text and picture.

prev_fleet.title: Previous Fleet Arrow
prev_fleet.about: The PREV arrow at the left end of the status band; a click selects the previous fleet.

status_band.title: Status Band
status_band.about: Strip under the inset map with the Prev arrow, the hovered star's name or stack line, and the Next arrow.

next_fleet.title: Next Fleet Arrow
next_fleet.about: The NEXT arrow at the right end of the status band; a click selects the next fleet.

btn_all.title: All Button
btn_all.about: Button labelled All (key A) that selects every ship of the stack; sits in the button band at the lower right.

btn_relocate.title: Relocate Button
btn_relocate.about: Hidden field (key R) that starts relocation of the selected ships; HD draws the word and lights it while relocate mode is on.

btn_scrap.title: Scrap Button
btn_scrap.about: Button labelled Scrap (key S) that scraps the selected ships; live only with ships selected and relocate mode off.

btn_leaders.title: Leaders Button
btn_leaders.about: Slanted button labelled Leaders (key L) in the lower row of the button band; opens the fleet's officers.

btn_support.title: Support Filter Button
btn_support.about: Radio button labelled Support (key U) in the button band; toggles the support-ship filter of the icon grid.

btn_combat.title: Combat Filter Button
btn_combat.about: Radio button labelled Combat (key C) in the button band; toggles the combat-ship filter of the icon grid.

btn_return.title: Return Button
btn_return.about: Slanted button labelled Return (key Esc) at the lower right of the button band; leaves the Fleets screen.

ship_panel_text.title: Ship Data Text
ship_panel_text.about: The scanned ship's lines, drawn top down; text stops short of the ship picture when one is drawn.

ship_picture.title: Scanned Ship Picture
ship_picture.about: A large picture of the scanned ship (HD addition), drawn at the right of the ship panel; empty when nothing is scanned.

icon_area.title: Ship Icon Area
icon_area.about: The panel at the upper right that holds the grid of ship icons and the scroll column.

button_band.title: Button Band
button_band.about: The panel at the lower right behind the seven action buttons.

status_text.title: Status Text
status_text.about: Right-click help area (help 363) of the middle of the status band; the hovered star or stack name itself is drawn by the band.

scroll_column.title: Scroll Column
scroll_column.about: The scroll bar at the right edge of the icon area; it scrolls the grid of ship icons.

inset_hint.title: Inset Hint
inset_hint.about: A hint line on the inset map telling that the map view belongs to the game window.

status_hint.title: Status Hint
status_hint.about: Hint line drawn in the status band while nothing is scanned, telling to hover a stack in the game window.

help_popup.title: Help Panel
help_popup.about: Shown only while right-click help is open; holds the help text for the clicked control.
